name: Role player: Okayu Shimai no Nenmaku Portrait - Gurigucha LIVE!
original_name: Role player：小粥姉妹の粘膜ポトレ ぐりぐちゃLIVE！
source: This is story about a manga artist who is dissatisfied with his work and draws adult manga under a different name. He finds himself at a resort called "Costaria," where he encounters a pair of sisters who want to act out the scenarios from his adult manga.
translation: 这是关于一位漫画家对自己的作品不满意并以不同的名字绘制成人漫画的故事。他发现自己来到了一个名为“Costaria”的度假村，在那里他遇到了一对想要表演他的成人漫画中的场景的姐妹。
